summary: Short interview clip in which Nick Huber explains how he protects his time by saying no to most opportunities, including a historic-property project suited to Bolt Builders, his company with an offshore architecture back office. He recounts one Twitter thread in January 2021 gaining 40,000 followers and changing his trajectory. He describes writing his book, an 18-22 month project with a $500k HarperCollins advance, as a delayed-gratification marshmallow test. Whisper transcript.

steps: Let the team ignore most inbound emails

lessons.lesson: One great piece of content can change a career trajectory; inspiration timing is unpredictable, so act when it hits.
